title: Make-Up Relief of Late Fees on PracticePay Patient Financing Plans
content:
**Courtesy waivers and make-up reliefs.** On a PracticePay Patient Financing plan, a courtesy waiver is granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the plan, and it is also granted without a request as a make-up relief, which is a late-fee relief or a returned-payment-fee relief under the make-up relief schedules, when fewer than that number have been granted; every make-up relief is booked on the courtesy basis and counts among those courtesy waivers, a fee whose make-up relief is owed is relieved under its schedule rather than waived on request.

**The late-fee relief.** Under the late-fee relief schedule, a late fee is relieved once the monthly payment it was charged for has been made up after the fee and the make-up has cleared, as one courtesy-basis waiver of that late-fee entry, never more than the part of the fee not already waived.

| Question | Answer under this policy |
|---|---|
| Does the patient need to ask? | No; the relief is granted without a request once it is owed. |
| On what basis is it booked? | The courtesy basis; it counts among the plan's courtesy waivers. |
| How many entries? | One waiver of that late-fee entry. |
| Can it exceed the fee? | No; never more than the part of the fee not already waived. |
| A late-fee relief that works out to 0.00? | Not owed; nothing is booked. |

## Booking tool: `relieve_late_fee_b1a4bf3c`

**Capability.** Books one waiver entry on the plan's ledger, dated today, on the courtesy basis, naming the late-fee entry it relieves, and lowers the plan balance by the amount relieved. The patient sees the relief on the plan's ledger and in the lower balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `relieve_late_fee_b1a4bf3c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `pos_plan_id` — reference number of the PracticePay plan, as returned by the PracticePay plan lookup. Identifier.
- `related_txn_id` — reference number of the late-fee entry being relieved, as shown by the PracticePay ledger lookup for that plan. Identifier.
- `relief_amount` — the amount relieved in USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount; stored rounded to the cent.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `pos_txn_id` (reference number of the waiver entry), `pos_plan_id`, `related_txn_id` (the late-fee entry relieved), `relief_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `waiver_reason` (the courtesy basis the entry is booked on), `relief_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `plan_balance` (the plan balance after the relief, USD with 2 decimal places). A `pos_txn_id` in the receipt means the relief is booked.
